copy.tagline: 用 Chat SDK 接入 WhatsApp 官方消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要接入 WhatsApp 消息的应用。
copy.tagline_en: Add WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel via Chat SDK
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app that needs WhatsApp messaging.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按步骤把 WhatsApp Cloud 适配器复制进项目、注册、装依赖并构建测试,随后项目就能通过官方 Meta API 收发 WhatsApp 私聊消息。
howto.when: 当你在 NanoClaw 项目中执行安装/添加渠道流程,需要接入 WhatsApp 时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 WhatsApp Cloud 渠道加进来
say.note: 开始复制适配器、注册并安装依赖。

say.text: 用 Cloud API 接 WhatsApp

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude copies the WhatsApp Cloud adapter into the project, registers it, installs a pinned dependency, builds and runs tests. The project can then exchange WhatsApp direct messages via the official Meta API.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you run the add-channel setup in a NanoClaw-capable project and need to connect WhatsApp.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp Cloud channel for me.
say_en.note: Starts copying, registration and dependency install.

say_en.text: Connect WhatsApp using the Cloud API.
say_en.note: Same as triggering the add flow.
